proposition: Bāysunghur's patronage was granted in two ways the pages show: he received Ibn Turka with particular favour (letter 19), and he asked for the R. Suʾl al-Mulūk, an introductory work on practical-magical and theoretical lettrism.

mediation.note: Letters to third parties ask or offer favours; the text survives only in copies made after his lifetime (except the marginal letters in MS Majlis 10196).
